interventions.title: High-visibility mid-block crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a safe, designated path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane striping
interventions.description: Apply standard lane markings to the roadway to better organize traffic flow and encourage slower speeds through narrower perceived lanes.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: Implement a marked mid-block crossing equipped with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to provide a safe crossing point on this long block.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe crossing point for hospital visitors.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-actuated warning lights to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing the wide arterial.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Repurpose a portion of the wide roadway for a protected bike lane, which would narrow the vehicle travel way and provide an additional buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at the new crossing.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number or width of travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and repurpose space for protected bike lanes or wider buffers.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Reducing the width of travel lanes or repurposing a lane for a protected bike lane would naturally slow traffic and provide a greater buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extension
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers by moving the waiting area past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway using street trees or planters to improve pedestrian comfort and physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a central pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width or number of travel lanes to slow traffic and potentially repurpose space for a protected bike lane.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with curb extensions to provide a safe, visible crossing point to the park.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Add signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians, particularly near the park entrance.
